comment: External-baseline experiments infrastructure. Every numeric setting from the specification is stored verbatim. This file is configuration only; the full experiments are not run by the infrastructure phase.

preprocessing.day_index_rule_contact: calendar date difference from first event date

M4.name: scm
M4.note: triangle reinforcement ratio lambda_Delta/lambda = 8, fixed a priori

mechanisms.node_hazard: sum_{h containing i} c_h(t) * Lambda(|h|, chi_h)

candidates.sg: static union simple graph over a supplied period; z = infected-neighbor count
candidates.g: binary pairwise projection of snapshot t; z = infected-neighbor count
candidates.mg: w_ij(t) = sum_h c_h * 1[{i,j} subset h]; z = sum_j w_ij * x_j
candidates.c2: kappa=2 maximal generated simplices; size<=3 kept as is; size>3 expanded into all 3-subsets, each repeated c_h times; z1 = sum_{sigma containing i} chi_sigma, z2 = sum_{sigma containing i} C(chi_sigma,2)
candidates.lower_model_prediction: p = 1 - exp(-h^T z), global time-invariant h >= 0

fitting.initial_value_convention: converted to h-space as -log1p(-start), matching exp_results_revision.fit_model
fitting.bernoulli_ml: maximum likelihood on observed SI transitions for later BIC use

simulation.type: batched SI with common random numbers
simulation.uniforms_shape: runs x T x N, supplied externally

calibration.initial_infected: one uniformly random node per run

training_period.contact: first ceil(D/2) calendar days, D = number of distinct calendar-day indices in kept data

external_methods.aggregate: unique, unweighted hyperedges of sizes 2..6 from the training period

lucas.tau: find_charact_tau(H0, orders, weights, rescale_per_node=True, sparse_Lap=True, idx=-1)
lucas.d_star: orders[argmin(D + lZ)]; reduced model keeps orders 1..d*, i.e. hyperedge sizes <= d*+1
